page_title: EIN 1-1 WOL | Eintracht Frankfurt v Wolfsburg 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' That's the end of the game for Lovro Majer, who is replaced by Pharell Hensel (Wolfsburg).
90+6' 1 - 1 Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the top left corner, ricocheting in off the post. Kamil Grabara was helpless.
90+5' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Harm Osmers lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+5' The main referee, Harm Osmers, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+5' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) is cautioned by the referee.
90+4' Having seen unsporting behavior, Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Daniel Bauer (Wolfsburg) is the recipient.
90+4' It’s a PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt after the VAR review!
90+2' Referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+1' Kamil Grabara leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' A pass into the penalty area from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
86' Substitution. Christian Eriksen walks off the pitch and Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
86' Here is a change. Yannick Gerhardt is going off and Daniel Bauer gives the last tactical orders to Vini Souza (Wolfsburg).
82' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff is replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

79' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Eintracht Frankfurt force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Ellyes Skhiri.
75' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
71' Daniel Bauer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) replacing Patrick Wimmer.
71' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed Amoura.
70' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
67' 0 - 1 Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and sends a low drive past the goalkeeper.
66' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
66' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the corner kick.

65' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. It will be a corner kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
65' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
63' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) handles the ball inside the penalty area. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
62' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Mario Gotze will be replaced by Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
62' Jean-Matteo Bahoya goes off the pitch and Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.

59' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Michael Zetterer pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
56' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
55' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
52' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
51' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

47' What a poor attempt! Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Harm Osmers has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes just a short run up and his weak long-range free kick is blocked by the defensive wall.
45+1' Kamil Grabara leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt).
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

43' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
42' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner.
42' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.

42' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
37' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
33' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

32' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner.
32' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Michael Zetterer.
29' Wolfsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
25' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
23' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.

19' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar.

12' Ooh that was close! Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
11' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
7' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
7' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
6' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
3' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
